At CaratLuck Casino, every game can be the start of a new story. Choose familiar favourites, discover something different and enjoy the moments that make you want to come back for more.

We value your curiosity and reward your activity. Find a game you love, collect Chips and unlock more opportunities with us.

Welcome Offers and Registration

Get started at our casino with a welcome offer that suits your gaming preferences. The Casino Welcome Pack combines bonus funds with free spins, the VIP Welcome Pack provides larger deposit bonuses, and the CaratLuck Crypto Welcome Pack is designed for players who prefer digital currencies.

Start playing with CaratLuck welcome bonuses. The Casino Welcome Pack includes up to 400% and 400 free spins, while the VIP Welcome Pack offers up to 500% in deposit bonuses. Each offer has its own activation conditions, minimum deposit requirements and wagering rules.

To join CaratLuck, simply create your personal account. Registration involves just a few straightforward steps:

  • Open the registration form on our website.
  • Complete the required fields with accurate personal information.
  • Verify your email address and accept the Terms and Conditions.
  • Sign in to your account, open the cashier and choose an available deposit method.

Registration is available to players aged 18 or over from countries where online gambling is permitted. Each player may create only one personal account, which must not be shared with anyone else. To claim bonuses, you must provide your personal details, verify your email address and meet the conditions of the relevant promotion.

Once your account is set up, you can deposit funds and enjoy the available bonuses. If you already play with us, just log in to CaratLuck and pick up where you left off.

Why We Are Unique

At CaratLuck, we've created a rewards system that goes beyond traditional casino bonuses. Our Chips Shop lets you exchange accumulated points not only for gaming rewards but also for real gift cards from popular brands. This means your activity can unlock gifts that aren't directly related to casino games.

In the Shop, you'll find gift cards from Amazon, Apple, Netflix, Nike and Uber. You can choose a reward that matches your interests, from digital entertainment and shopping to everyday services. Each gift has its own price in Chips, and the selection may change depending on availability.

Our rewards don't stop at gift cards. The Shop also includes bonus funds, cash rewards and free spins. You decide how to use your accumulated points, whether you'd like to redeem them straight away or save up for a more valuable gift. The advertised Chips Shop prize pool totals €300,000.

We also offer a broad choice of entertainment and payment options. Traditional banking methods are complemented by cryptocurrencies, while dedicated bonus packages let you choose the welcome offer that suits you. Our support team is available around the clock via live chat, so help with your account, payments or promotions is available 24/7.

Security Standards and Technical Reliability

We take the protection of personal information, account security and financial transaction monitoring seriously. Our security procedures include Know Your Customer (KYC) checks, transaction monitoring and measures to prevent fraud and money laundering. Identity verification helps us confirm that an account belongs to its rightful owner and that payments are made through legitimate means.

Verification may involve a two-stage document check. Depending on the circumstances, we may request:

  • A passport, national identity card or driving licence to confirm your identity.
  • A selfie holding your identification document to verify account ownership.
  • Proof of address, such as a bank statement or utility bill issued within the last three months.
  • Additional information about your payment method or source of funds if further transaction checks are required.

KYC verification is mandatory when requesting a withdrawal, when your cumulative deposits exceed €2,000 or when suspicious activity is detected. We may also request verification earlier, regardless of the amount deposited, depending on your payment method, country of residence and the nature of the transaction. We apply different levels of checks — SDD, CDD and EDD — according to the assessed risk.

Deposits exceeding €5,000 are subject to additional Source of Wealth checks. These help us confirm that funds come from legitimate sources and may involve documents relating to employment income, business activities, investments, inheritance or other sources of funds. If the information provided is insufficient, we may request further evidence before completing the verification process.

We use personal information to manage accounts, process payments, verify identities and meet applicable requirements. Technical and organisational safeguards help us protect your data, and we do not sell personal information to third parties. Certain details may, however, be shared with authorised service providers, payment partners or relevant authorities where permitted or required by our policies.

Loyalty System

Every new level in our loyalty programme brings additional opportunities. Our VIP Club includes Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum tiers, each divided into four levels. Obsidian is the highest status, sitting above the main ranking system. Your progress depends on the points you accumulate, with the journey beginning at Bronze I.

Members can receive level-up bonuses, daily cashback and Live Casino rakeback. As your VIP status grows, you'll gain access to additional benefits, including exclusive tournaments, promotional codes, increased withdrawal limits and priority support. Higher tiers also offer assistance from a personal VIP manager, while Obsidian status may unlock cash gifts.

Alongside the VIP Club, our Chips system rewards deposits and slot activity. Every €1 deposited earns 50 Chips, while a €1 slot wager earns 100 Chips. You can use your accumulated points in the Chips Shop to redeem available rewards.

Gaming rewards include packages of 5, 10, 20, 40 or 50 free spins. You can also choose bonus funds and cash rewards. Each item has a set price in Chips, and the availability of individual offers depends on the Shop's current selection.

You can enjoy your first VIP benefits even before moving up the ranks. We've created the VIP Welcome Pack with bonuses on your initial deposits. As you progress through our loyalty programme, further rewards become available at higher levels.

Entertainment Catalog

From classic reels to live dealer tables, our game library includes more than 12,400 titles from 106 providers. Explore our Top selection, check out the latest releases in New or browse Popular to discover games attracting attention from other players. We've also created dedicated Bonus Friendly, Jackpot and Buy Bonus categories for different gaming preferences.

In Slots, you can move from traditional fruit machines to modern video slots with additional features. Popular titles include Wanted Dead or a Wild, Mahjong Ways 2, Fortune Tiger and 3 Hot Chillies. For something different, try Golden Joker 100 Hold And Win or Luck of Panda: Bonus Combo. Slots with a Bonus Buy feature let you purchase access to bonus rounds according to the rules of each game.

Live Casino brings familiar table games to life with real dealers. Join a roulette, blackjack or baccarat table, choose a classic variation or try faster-paced formats such as Lightning Roulette, Speed Baccarat and Infinite Blackjack. Poker games are also available, with tables offering different rules, round speeds and betting limits.

For shorter gaming sessions, we've brought together a selection of games with straightforward mechanics. In crash games, the outcome depends on when you choose to cash out, while Plinko, Mines, Dice and Keno offer different ways to play. You can also explore Bingo and interactive formats that provide an alternative to traditional slots and table games.

Our Jackpot category is there for anyone interested in games with larger prize pools. You'll find Ozwin's Jackpots, Jackpot Raiders, Super Fire Jackpot and other titles featuring jackpot mechanics. We also advertise a jackpot of up to €1,000,000. The amount, type and eligibility requirements for each prize depend on the individual game or promotion.

Our library brings together games from Hacksaw Gaming, BGaming, Playson, Booongo, Iconic21 and other studios. Browse by category, theme or gameplay features to find something you enjoy. The availability of individual games may vary depending on your country and the provider's requirements.

Deposit and Withdrawal

Top up your gaming balance through the cashier using the payment methods available for your account. We support Visa, Mastercard, Interac, Skrill, Apple Pay, Google Pay and cryptocurrency payments. Supported digital currencies include Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron and Tether. Available payment options depend on your country, account currency and transaction type.

Deposits must be made using bank accounts, cards, e-wallets or other payment methods registered in your own name. Minimum and maximum deposit amounts depend on the chosen method and are displayed in the cashier. Additional fees or currency conversion may apply depending on the payment provider. Our casino's internal settlement currency is the euro.

Before withdrawing deposited funds that were not linked to a bonus, you must meet a 1x turnover requirement. If you have an active bonus, the funds associated with it are subject to the terms of that promotion. Withdrawals of bonus winnings also require you to meet the relevant conditions and complete identity verification.

To request a withdrawal, open the cashier in your account, select an available payment method and enter the amount. Under our AML rules, withdrawals must be made using the same payment method as the initial deposit. The payment method must belong to the account holder. Before processing your request, we may ask for KYC documents or additional transaction verification.

We process withdrawal requests within three working days. The time taken for funds to reach your account then depends on your bank or payment provider. Minimum and maximum withdrawal amounts vary by payment method, while daily, weekly and monthly limits are governed by separate rules. Members of higher VIP tiers may qualify for individual conditions.

Your Next Experience Starts Here

Your next gaming experience begins with a single choice. Open a favourite slot, join a live dealer table or discover something new among thousands of available games. Whenever you're ready for more, return to the Chips Shop, follow your VIP progress and unlock new rewards.

We want gaming to remain an enjoyable part of your leisure time. CaratLuck is strictly for players aged 18 or over, and anyone who needs a break can request temporary self-exclusion through our support team. During the exclusion period, access to your account, financial transactions and promotions is suspended. Play responsibly, at your own pace and for the enjoyment of the experience.

pages.content:
At RossoWin, we run promotions for slots and sports betting fans. Our RossoWin Bonus selection includes Early Payout for football bets, jackpots worth up to €1,000,000, Lucky Boom with a €600,000 prize pool and the weekly Big Sunday Blast tournament offering €25,000 every Sunday. Each promotion has its own entry requirements, reward mechanics and rules for determining winners.

Early Payout on Football Bets at RossoWin

Has your team taken a two-goal lead? With Early Payout, we'll settle your eligible bet as a winner before the final whistle. Even if the opposition later equalises or wins the match, your already settled bet remains a winner.

The feature applies to pre-match bets on a home or away win in the 1X2 market. For example, you've backed Arsenal to win and they take a 2-0 lead. If the match qualifies for the promotion, your bet is settled as a winner straight away. Early Payout is triggered whenever your selected team takes a lead of at least two goals during normal time.

We offer Early Payout on selected matches in the Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1 and the UEFA Conference League. Eligible events carry a dedicated Early Payout label in our sportsbook. The list of supported matches and competitions may change.

The following conditions apply:

  • You must place your bet before kick-off on either a home or away win. Draw selections and in-play bets do not qualify.

  • Early settlement is available only for events marked Early Payout. If a match is cancelled or postponed, our standard sports betting settlement rules apply.

Once the Early Payout conditions have been met, the bet is permanently settled as a winner. Later events in the match will not change the settlement. This RossoWin Bonus feature applies exclusively to eligible pre-match football selections.

RossoWin Casino Bonus Jackpot With a Prize Pool of up to €1,000,000

Our jackpot promotion runs across selected slots, giving you an opportunity to win a prize independently of the base game's outcome. The maximum jackpot can reach €1,000,000, while the current prize pool may change depending on player activity. You can find eligible jackpot slots in the dedicated casino section.

We offer two types of jackpots. A Fixed Jackpot has a predetermined prize amount, which may depend on your stake in certain games. Some prizes may require a maximum bet. A Progressive Jackpot grows through qualifying spins and resets once the top prize has been won.

Only real-money play on eligible slots qualifies for the promotion. Every qualifying spin may trigger a jackpot, but bonus balance bets, free spins and other promotional spins are excluded. The requirements for each jackpot, including any minimum or maximum stake conditions, are displayed within the game.

The jackpot operates separately from the slot's main mechanics and return to player (RTP). Results are determined by the game provider's jackpot system or our internal software. This means a win in the base game and the chance of triggering a jackpot are independent of each other.

Unlike a traditional deposit-based RossoWin Bonus offer, our jackpot promotion awards prizes directly to your real-money balance without additional wagering requirements on the jackpot winnings themselves. If automatic crediting fails for technical reasons, we may add a verified prize manually. Payouts may be voided in cases of software errors or incorrect jackpot triggers, in accordance with the promotion's rules.

Lucky Boom at RossoWin With a €600,000 Prize Pool

Lucky Boom is a network-wide promotion from Playson and Booongo, where cash prizes are awarded at random through qualifying spins. The total prize pool is €600,000, with €30,000 allocated to each stage. The campaign runs from 21 September 2026 to 7 February 2027, making it one of our largest RossoWin Casino Bonus promotions.

There is no traditional leaderboard based on points or total winnings. Every qualifying spin in an eligible slot can award a random cash prize. All players who meet the requirements have an equal chance on each qualifying spin. You can win multiple prizes throughout the campaign, provided rewards remain available.

To join Lucky Boom, choose eligible slots from Playson or Booongo. You must complete at least 100 spins with a minimum stake of €0.50 per spin to qualify. The participating game selection is determined by the providers.

When a spin awards a Lucky Boom prize, you'll receive a win notification. Once you confirm it, the reward is automatically credited to your balance. If you fail to claim the prize within 90 days, your entitlement expires.

Prizes are distributed among players across the entire Playson and Booongo network, not just those playing at our casino. Rewards come in several fixed denominations, so individual prize amounts may vary. Technical errors can affect prize crediting, and the organisers reserve the right to amend the campaign's terms.

Big Sunday Blast Tournament With a €25,000 Prize Pool

Big Sunday Blast takes place every Sunday, with a €25,000 prize pool for each tournament day. Organised by Playson and Booongo, this RossoWin Casino Bonus tournament is available in selected slots from both providers. It starts at 02:00 UTC and ends at 23:59 UTC. The promotion runs until 7 March 2027.

Unlike Lucky Boom, this tournament uses a leaderboard to determine the winners. We count the highest win multiplier you achieve on a single spin. The system is called HSRM (Highest Single Round Multiplier). For example, if you stake €2 and win €50, your result is x25, earning you 25 tournament points. That score stays on the leaderboard until you achieve a higher multiplier.

To qualify, you must complete at least 100 spins with a minimum stake of €0.50. Spins made using real money or bonus funds count, but free spins are excluded. Until you meet these conditions, your leaderboard result may appear as inactive.

The leaderboard updates during play, allowing you to follow your position against other participants. If two players achieve the same multiplier, the player who reached it first takes the higher position. An additional five minutes is allowed after the tournament ends to finalise the results.

The prize pool is distributed among the top 150 players as follows:

After the tournament ends, prizes are credited as real money and are available for withdrawal. If automatic payment is unavailable, we may credit prizes manually once the organisers confirm the results. In cases of technical errors or exceptional circumstances, the tournament may be amended or cancelled in accordance with the providers' rules.

How to Join RossoWin Tournaments and Promotions

To participate in our RossoWin bonus promotions, simply sign in to your profile. Most slot promotions do not require a separate promo code. Choose an eligible game and meet the entry requirements for the event. In our sportsbook, you'll find the Early Payout label next to qualifying football matches and markets.

Entry requirements vary by promotion:

  • Early Payout — select an eligible football match and place a pre-match 1X2 bet on either team to win.

  • Jackpot — open a slot linked to the jackpot promotion and place qualifying real-money bets.

  • Lucky Boom — complete at least 100 spins of €0.50 or more in participating slots for a chance to receive a random cash prize.

  • Big Sunday Blast — play eligible Playson and Booongo slots on Sundays, meet the requirements and compete for the highest single-round multiplier.

We display current RossoWin Casino Bonus offers and their conditions in our promotions section. You can check campaign dates, eligible games, stake requirements and reward rules before taking part. Organisers may void prizes in cases of rule violations, result manipulation or technical errors.

All promotions are subject to their respective terms, and availability may change. We support responsible gambling. Participation in tournaments and prize draws does not guarantee a win, so keep your stakes within your personal limits and stay in control of your spending.

pages.title: Login
pages.content:
Log in to RossoWin Casino to return to your favourite slots, sports betting and gaming balance. The RossoWin Casino Login gives you access to your personal profile, transaction history, active bets and account settings. Everything you need to manage your gaming activity is available after signing in.

Use the details you provided during registration to access your account. If you've forgotten your password or are having trouble signing in, you can recover access. We also have identity verification and security measures in place to protect your personal information and financial transactions.

How to Log In to Your RossoWin Account

Already registered? There's no need to create another account. The RossoWin Login process lets you continue playing with your existing balance and access your personal settings using your registered credentials.

To sign in to your account:

  1. Open the RossoWin website and click Login at the top of the page.

  2. Enter the email address linked to your account.

  3. Type in the password you created during registration.

  4. Click Login to complete the sign-in process.

Once you've completed the RossoWin Casino Login, you can return to your games, check your balance or open your profile settings. We use one personal account for both casino games and sports betting, so you don't need to create a separate profile for the sportsbook.

What You Can Do After RossoWin Login

Your RossoWin account brings together the main features for managing your gaming activity and personal details. After signing in, you can check your current balance, view financial transactions and follow the status of your withdrawal requests.

Your profile also contains your account information and verification status. If additional documents are required to confirm your identity, we may notify you during the verification process. Completing KYC is necessary before withdrawing winnings.

Our casino and sportsbook share the same balance, allowing you to switch between slots and sports betting without transferring funds between separate accounts. You can also return to available promotions, check tournament terms and view the rewards you've received.

RossoWin Casino Login Problems and Password Recovery

If your password isn't working, first check that you've entered the correct email address without any extra spaces. Passwords are case-sensitive, so check your keyboard layout and make sure Caps Lock isn't enabled. A simple typing error can prevent you from completing the RossoWin Login process.

If you can't remember your password, use the password recovery option in the login window, if available. Follow the instructions to verify your email address and create a new password. Once you've changed it, use your updated details to sign in.

If the RossoWin Casino Login page doesn't accept your correct details or isn't working properly, try the following:

  • Refresh the login page and enter your details manually.

  • Check your internet connection and try opening the website in another browser.

  • Clear your browser's cookies and cache if the login form fails to load or displays errors.

  • If your access has been restricted following a security check, contact our support team.

We may ask you to verify your identity before restoring access to your account. This helps protect your personal information and funds against unauthorised access. Don't create a new profile to replace a blocked account, as RossoWin allows only one account per player.

Secure RossoWin Login and Account Protection

For secure access, use a unique password that you don't use on other websites. Never share your login details with anyone or save your password on shared devices. If you sign in from someone else's computer, always log out when you've finished using your account.

Only access RossoWin through the correct website address. Fake login pages may copy our casino's name and appearance to steal personal information. We never ask you to share your password in live chat or send it alongside your identity verification documents.

During security checks, we may temporarily restrict certain account functions and request additional identity verification. Financial transactions are permitted only through payment methods belonging to the account holder. This rule also applies to withdrawal requests.

If you notice unfamiliar transactions, changes to your personal details or suspicious activity, change your password and contact our support team. We'll review your report and help you take the appropriate steps to secure your account.
